description: Rothco’s Tactical MOLLE Bottle Carrier is designed to provide you access to hydration during any mission or outdoor activity. This MOLLE pouch integrates with anything with a MOLLE panel, making it perfect for soldiers, public safety professionals, MilSim players, and more. This water bottle carrier features four rows of MOLLE webbing plus two six-inch MOLLE straps with snap closures for mounting on assault packs, tactical belts, and plate carrier vests. A drawstring closure with a barrel lock adjuster at the top of the MOLLE water bottle pouch secures your water supply during intense activities. The bottle carrier measures 8.75 inches tall with a 3.5-inch diameter to accommodate most water bottles. An aerated mesh bottom helps drain excess water to keep the MOLLE attachment dry.
